Sara — thanks for the heads up and the note from procurement. We can absolutely rework the MAP. High level proposal now (I'll follow up with a tabletop and a refreshed MAP spreadsheet):

- Create a 2-tier acceptance band (Guardband): 
  1) Hard acceptance items (data plane, auth, core inference) — target window 11/29–12/07
  2) Soft acceptance items (analytics dashboards, extended integrations) — phased over 30 days after hard acceptance
- Canary: 48‑hour canary in prod with a preserved rollback plan and token‑level cost cap.
- Contingency: If procurement clearance slips > 14 days, shift hard acceptance to a minimum viable launch with feature gating and a documented downgrade path.
- Commercial: suggest a limited SLA credit (one month pro‑rated) if go‑live is delayed beyond the second guardband threshold.

Can Tom and procurement share the security committee timeline and any blocking artifacts? I'll loop in our delivery leads to decompose root causes for the slip and provide a remediation cadence.

I'll send the MAP-v2.xlsx shortly with the guardband columns and an explicit ownership table.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
